name: Golden Erinys Novitiate Circle

items.name: Opportunistic Halt
items.text:
Trigger A creature within 5 feet uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it's using

---
Effect The novitiates strike at the triggering creature, dealing 2d8+3 bludgeoning damage (DC 19 basic Reflex save save). If the save is a critical failure and the trigger was a move action, that action is disrupted.

items.name: Unholy Quickness
items.text: Sisters of the Golden Erinys are renowned for their uncanny reflexes, which grant them a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against ranged attacks.

items.name: Flurry of Vengeance
items.text:
1 to 3

Frequency once per round

---
Effect The novitiates unleash a barrage of painful unarmed blows against enemies in a 5-foot emanation (DC 19 basic Reflex save save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d8 piercing damage

2 2d8+3 piercing damage

3 2d8+7 piercing damage

items.name: Pain Points
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect The novitiates are taught how best to cause pain with their strikes. The novitiates use a 1-action Flurry of Vengeance. Each creature that fails its Reflex save is also Clumsy 1 for 1 round as its body is wracked with excruciating agony.

items.name: Storm of Blades
items.text: The novitiates unleash a hail of thrown blades, dealing 3d8 slashing damage in a 10-foot burst within 20 feet (DC 19 basic Reflex save save). When the novitiates are reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a 5-foot burst.

text: The convents of the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys train female monks who study a form of martial arts based on the devils of Hell.
